observations: Photo 0 shows a red PlayStation console with a large white Spider-Man logo, a red DualShock controller, a copy of the Marvel Spider-Man game, and several cables (HDMI, USB, power).

Photo 1 shows the same console and controller from a different angle, with the game case in front. The console has a glossy red finish with a white Spider-Man emblem and a small PlayStation logo in the top right.
Photo 2 shows the console from the side, revealing the 'PS4' branding on the left edge and the 'PRO' label near the bottom. The controller is red with white buttons and a black touchpad.
The console appears to be a custom or limited edition design, not the standard PS4 Pro model.
The game case is for 'Marvel Spider-Man' for PS4, published by Insomniac Games.
All items are arranged on a neutral gray surface, with watermarks from 'CASGAMING AND CASAUTOS' visible across the images.
